description: Two eligible runtimes race for one task; stale ownership cannot mutate the result.

steps.action: Submit simultaneous claims against the same Ready version
assertions: Exactly one claim wins and one conflicts.
Only the winning proof/run/fence may execute.
Trusted workspace policy classified this task replay-safe before execution; the claim audit retains that decision.

steps.action: Attempt run heartbeat with readable run ID and fence but wrong runtime proof
assertions: Agent membership alone cannot authenticate this runtime ownership.

steps.action: Expire the active run with known retry eligibility and budget
assertions: Old run ends expired; retry budget advances atomically.
A new fence is strictly greater than the expired attempt.

steps.action: Submit a late result using expired ownership
assertions: Current run and result remain unchanged.
